name: aimock
description: Mocks LLM APIs, MCP tools, A2A agents, AG-UI streams, and vector databases on one local port so AI app tests run offline and deterministically.

skills.name: Mock LLM Providers
skills.description: Mocks OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure, Vertex AI, Ollama, and other provider APIs from fixtures, streaming included.

skills.name: Record and Replay
skills.description: Records real API traffic through a proxy, saves it as fixtures, and replays it deterministically with the recorded timing.

skills.name: Mock MCP Servers
skills.description: Mocks MCP tools, resources, and prompts with session management so MCP clients can be tested without real servers.

skills.name: Mock A2A and AG-UI
skills.description: Mocks A2A agent-to-agent conversations with SSE streaming and AG-UI event streams for testing agent backends and frontends.

skills.name: Validate Fixtures
skills.description: Validates fixture files offline without starting a server and reports errors and warnings, with JSON output for CI.
